children: Technology demonstrations showcase next-generation contribution workflows with JPEG XS and AI-driven device management
MONTREAL, Sept. 10, 2026

, a leading global provider of mission‑critical, real‑time video networking and visual collaboration solutions, will highlight two major technology demonstrations at IBC2026 that underscore the company’s commitment to innovation and operational excellence across broadcast contribution workflows.

At this year’s show, Haivision will feature advancements in both lossless ultra-low latency video transport and intelligent device management, advancing its position as one of the most dynamic broadcast technology vendors in the industry.
JPEG XS Encoding and Decoding with the Makito ONE Video Transport Platform
Haivision will demonstrate JPEG XS encoding and decoding on the

video transport platform, designed for high-performance, ultra-low latency contribution workflows. The demonstration showcases how the Makito ONE implementation of JPEG XS provides visually lossless compression and sub-frame latency. JPEG XS is increasingly used in high-end sports remote production where camera feeds are transported over managed IP networks with precise timing, consistent color accuracy, and frame-accurate synchronization. This is critical for real-time production switching, replay operations, and centralized referee review systems.
AI
Powered Device Management within Haivision Hub 360

Haivision will also showcase new AI-powered device configuration capabilities integrated into Haivision Hub 360. This technology demonstration highlights how intelligent automation can assist and streamline setup, monitoring, and optimization of Haivision contribution devices - including video encoders, mobile transmitters, and IP gateways - within a unified cloud master control environment. This is especially useful in newsgathering workflows where non-technical users are responsible for capturing live video content and in sports and remote production workflows where teams are regularly managing many devices applied across diverse product use cases.
Driving the Future of Broadcast Contribution

With these technology demonstrations, Haivision is showcasing the next generation of intelligent, resilient, and efficient live video contribution. By advancing both video transport performance and operational efficiency, Haivision is reinforcing why it remains one of the most dynamic vendors in the broadcast technology landscape.
Experience the Technology Demonstration at IBC2026

Visitors to Haivision’s stand (Hall 2, 2.B32) can experience live demonstrations of Makito ONE JPEG XS and Haivision Hub 360 with AI-powered configuration firsthand. To schedule a meeting with Haivision at IBC2026, visit: https://www.haivision.com/events/ibc/.
About Haivision

Haivision is a leading global provider of mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions. Haivision enables organizations globally to engage audiences, enhance collaboration, and support decision-making. We provide high-quality, low-latency, secure, and reliable live video at a global scale. Haivision open-sourced its award-winning SRT low-latency video streaming protocol and founded the SRT Alliance to support its adoption. Awarded four Emmys® for Technology and Engineering from the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, Haivision continues to fuel the future of IP video transformation. Founded in 2004, Haivision is headquartered in Montreal and Chicago with offices, sales, and support located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia. To learn more, visit Haivision at www.haivision.com.
